Tamil Nadu Allocates Rs 6.85 Crore for VIP Protocol Expenses

The Tamil Nadu government has allocated an annual budget of Rs 6.85 crore for VIP and VVIP protocol arrangements. This funding will cover expenses related to security, accommodation, and transportation for dignitaries. The allocation aims to ensure smooth and efficient protocol management for high-profile individuals visiting the state.
